operagx-windows.name: Opera GX
operagx-windows.description: A web browser built for gamers, developed by Opera. Has speed, privacy, and customization features.

firefox-windows.name: Firefox
firefox-windows.description: An open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation. Designed to be lightweight, fast, and privacy-focused.

chrome-windows.name: Google Chrome
chrome-windows.description: A widely used web browser developed by Google. Known for its speed, performance, and user interface.

steam-windows.name: Steam
steam-windows.description: A popular video game distribution service developed by Valve. Known for its wide variety of available titles.

spotify-windows.name: Spotify
spotify-windows.description: A music and podcast streaming service developed by Spotify. Used by hundreds of millions around the world.

discord-windows.name: Discord
discord-windows.description: A social platform developed by Discord Inc. Used for messaging, making calls, and joining communities of like-minded people.

epicgames-windows.name: Epic Games Launcher
epicgames-windows.description: A popular video game distribution service developed by Epic Games. Known for its simple user interface and regular offering of free games.

7-zip-windows.name: 7-Zip
7-zip-windows.description: An-open source program developed by Igor Pavlov. Used to create and extract file archives.

vscode-windows.name: Visual Studio Code
vscode-windows.description: A code editor developed by Microsoft. Known for customization features, git integration, syntax highlighting, and much more.

python-3.13-windows.name: Python 3.13
python-3.13-windows.description: A Python programming language interpreter, used to run Python code. Developed by the Python Software Foundation. Python is known for its readability and clear syntax.

brave-browser-windows.name: Brave Browser
brave-browser-windows.description: A privacy-focused web browser developed by Brave Software, Inc. Known for features such as tracking protection, ad blocking, and more.

gimp-windows.name: GIMP
gimp-windows.description: A free and open source image editor developed by the GIMP Development Team. Used to create and edit images.

riot-valorant-na-windows.name: Riot Client (VALORANT NA)
riot-valorant-na-windows.description: A game launcher developed by Riot Games. This version is configured for NA servers and VALORANT. Used to install, update, and launch Riot's games all in one place.

capcut-windows.name: Capcut
capcut-windows.description: A video editor application developed by ByteDance. Known for its social media focused features and ease of use.

winrar-windows.name: WinRAR
winrar-windows.description: A file compression and decompression tool developed by RARLAB. Widely used to create and extract file archive formats such as ZIP and RAR.

streamlabs-windows.name: Streamlabs Desktop
streamlabs-windows.description: A screen recording and live streaming application developed by Streamlabs. Known for features that enable interaction with viewers, such as on screen alerts.

netflix-windows.name: Netflix
netflix-windows.description: A TV show and movie streaming service developed by Netflix, Inc. Known for its wide variety of content, including some original movies and series.

apple-music-windows.name: Apple Music
apple-music-windows.description: A music streaming service developed by Apple. Known for its high audio quality and ease of use.

apple-tv-windows.name: Apple TV
apple-tv-windows.description: A TV show and movie streaming service developed by Apple. Known for its wide variety of content and its original series.

tiktok-windows.name: TikTok
tiktok-windows.description: A social media platform developed by ByteDance. Used for watching, sharing, and creating short-form videos.

instagram-windows.name: Instagram
instagram-windows.description: A social media platform developed by Meta Platforms. Used for watching, sharing, and uploading photos and short-form videos.

minecraft-launcher-windows.name: Minecraft Launcher
minecraft-launcher-windows.description: A launcher for the game Minecraft developed by Microsoft. Minecraft is a popular sandbox game. Note: Installing the launcher is free, but playing Minecraft requires an account with Minecraft purchased on it.

badlion-client-windows.name: Badlion Client
badlion-client-windows.description: A Minecraft client developed by the Badlion team. Includes more than 100 mods and FPS boosts. Note: Installing the client is free, but playing Minecraft requires an account with Minecraft purchased on it.

lunar-client-windows.name: Lunar Client
lunar-client-windows.description: A Minecraft client developed by Moonsworth. Includes more than 60 mods and can increase FPS by more than 2x. Note: Installing the client is free, but playing Minecraft requires an account with Minecraft purchased on it.

retroarch-windows.name: RetroArch
retroarch-windows.description: A frontend for a variety of retro console emulators, developed by Libretro. Note: Installing the software is free, but playing games requires ROM files.

battlenet-windows.name: Battle.net
battlenet-windows.description: A video game distribution service and launcher developed by Blizzard. Known for hosting games such as Overwatch 2, Call of Duty, and World of Warcraft.

google-play-games-windows.name: Google Play Games Beta
google-play-games-windows.description: A video game client developed by Google. Known for allowing users to play select mobile games on PC with cloud saves.
